# Live Science

> > Live Science delivers breaking news and in-depth reporting on scientific discoveries across space exploration, archaeology, artificial intelligence, climate science, health, and emerging technologies.

Live Science covers the latest research and discoveries from leading scientific institutions including NASA, ESA, the James Webb Space Telescope, and archaeological teams worldwide. The site provides accessible science journalism on topics ranging from gravitational waves and black holes to ancient civilizations and AI developments.

## Key Topics

- Space exploration and astrophysics
- Archaeological discoveries
- Artificial intelligence and machine learning
- Climate change and environmental science
- James Webb Space Telescope observations
- Gravitational waves and cosmic collisions
- Black holes and neutron stars
- Astrobiology and extraterrestrial life
- Ancient civilizations (Scythian, Bronze Age, Pre-Roman)
- Emerging technologies and electric vehicles
- Health and medical anomalies
- Interstellar objects and comets
- Mathematical proofs and verification
- Human-nature mutualism
- Energy production and AI infrastructure

## Space and Astrophysics

- [Universe-shaking collision of black hole and neutron star could upend our understanding of monster cosmic mergers](https://www.livescience.com/space/black-holes/universe-shaking-collision-of-black-hole-and-neutron-star-could-upend-our-understanding-of-monster-cosmic-mergers): Gravitational wave analysis challenges theories on black hole-neutron mergers
- ['Interstellar messenger' 3I/ATLAS could be nearly as old as the universe itself, James Webb telescope observations reveal](https://www.livescience.com/space/comets/interstellar-messenger-3i-atlas-could-be-nearly-as-old-as-the-universe-itself-james-webb-telescope-observations-reveal): JWST reveals comet 3I/ATLAS may be 12 billion years old from early Milky Way
- [A 'mass migration' of stars from the Milky Way's center could explain why there's life in our solar system](https://www.livescience.com/space/a-mass-migration-of-stars-from-the-milky-ways-center-could-explain-why-theres-life-in-our-solar-system): Gaia telescope finds 6,000+ sun-like stars migrated from galactic center
- [Exceptionally rare sighting of planets colliding may shed light on the crash that formed the moon](https://www.livescience.com/space/exceptionally-rare-sighting-of-planets-colliding-may-shed-light-on-the-crash-that-formed-the-moon): Star Gaia20ehk shows signs of planetary collision mirroring Moon formation
- [Scientists squished microbes into a steel 'sandwich' — and made a profound discovery about life in space](https://www.livescience.com/space/extraterrestrial-life/scientists-squished-microbes-into-a-steel-sandwich-and-made-a-profound-discovery-about-life-in-space): Extremophile bacteria survive asteroid impact tests supporting panspermia
- [Neutron star merger hiding in mini-galaxy could answer 2 big astrophysics questions](https://www.livescience.com/space/astronomy/a-collision-within-a-collision-neutron-star-merger-hiding-in-mini-galaxy-could-answer-2-big-astrophysics-questions): NASA/ESA observe neutron star merger in dwarf galaxy collision

## Artificial Intelligence and Technology

- [Computing power is no longer the AI bottleneck — it's energy production](https://www.livescience.com/technology/artificial-intelligence/computing-power-is-no-longer-the-ai-bottleneck-its-energy-production): Energy production now limits AI growth more than computing power
- [AI hallucinations work both ways, study shows — using chatbots can amplify and reinforce our own delusions](https://www.livescience.com/technology/artificial-intelligence/generative-ai-can-amplify-and-reinforce-our-delusions-findings-show): Chatbots like ChatGPT can amplify human cognitive biases and delusions
- [AI just verified a proof that earned one of math's most prestigious prizes. Math will never be the same](https://www.livescience.com/physics-mathematics/mathematics/ai-just-verified-a-proof-that-earned-one-of-maths-most-prestigious-prizes-math-will-never-be-the-same-opinion): AI verifies Maryna Viazovska's Fields Medal sphere-packing proof
- [Giant 10-person 'flying taxi' passes first flight test in China](https://www.livescience.com/technology/electric-vehicles/giant-10-person-flying-taxi-passes-first-flight-test-in-china): China's V5000 eVTOL aircraft completes first flight carrying 10 passengers

## Climate and Environmental Science

- ['Blackwater' lakes and rivers in the Congo Basin are now emitting ancient carbon into the atmosphere](https://www.livescience.com/planet-earth/blackwater-lakes-and-rivers-in-the-congo-basin-are-now-emitting-ancient-carbon-into-the-atmosphere): Congo Basin peatlands releasing millennia-old carbon into waterways
- [Early warning indicator hidden within the Gulf Stream could signal AMOC collapse, study finds](https://www.livescience.com/planet-earth/rivers-oceans/early-warning-signal-hidden-within-the-gulf-stream-could-signal-the-collapse-of-key-atlantic-currents-study-finds): Gulf Stream shifts may predict Atlantic Meridional Overturning collapse

## Archaeological Discoveries

- [Russian Revolution gold coin hoard worth over $500,000 discovered during house construction](https://www.livescience.com/archaeology/russian-revolution-gold-coin-hoard-worth-over-usd500-000-discovered-during-house-construction): 409 Imperial Russian gold coins from 1917 found in Torzhok excavation
- [1,900-year-old double Scythian burial in Ukraine contains toxic red mineral](https://www.livescience.com/archaeology/1-900-year-old-double-scythian-burial-in-ukraine-contains-toxic-red-mineral): Late Scythian double burial in Ukraine features toxic cinnabar mineral
- [Children wearing bronze 'warrior' belts discovered in 2,500-year-old cemetery in Italy](https://www.livescience.com/archaeology/children-wearing-bronze-warrior-belts-discovered-in-2-500-year-old-cemetery-in-italy): Pre-Roman children buried as warriors in Pontecagnano Samnite cemetery
- [Europe's oldest handgun may date to 14th-century siege at German castle](https://www.livescience.com/archaeology/europes-oldest-handgun-may-date-to-14th-century-siege-at-german-castle): 1390 handgun from Brandenburg castle predates Tannenberg rifle discovery
- [Man in Czech Republic accidentally finds Bronze Age spearhead mold in his backyard](https://www.livescience.com/archaeology/man-in-czech-republic-accidentally-finds-bronze-age-spearhead-mold-in-his-backyard): Bronze Age rhyolite spearhead mold found in Czech backyard barn foundation

## Health and Biology

- ['It's nature calling to humans, and humans deciding whether or not to reply': Why we need to start paying attention to our mutually beneficial relationships with other species](https://www.livescience.com/animals/its-nature-calling-to-humans-and-humans-deciding-whether-or-not-to-reply-why-we-need-to-start-paying-attention-to-our-mutually-beneficial-relationships-with-other-species): Rob Dunn discusses mutualism between humans and honeyguide birds in Africa
- [Diagnostic dilemma: Woman born without a vagina or cervix went on to conceive a son naturally](https://www.livescience.com/health/fertility-pregnancy-birth/diagnostic-dilemma-woman-born-without-a-vagina-or-cervix-went-on-to-conceive-a-son-naturally): UK woman with cervical/vaginal agenesis achieves natural conception
- [Here are the top 5 mistakes to avoid when using an air purifier this hayfever season](https://www.livescience.com/health/allergies/top-5-mistakes-when-using-air-purifiers-during-hay-fever-season): AAFA expert shares common air purifier mistakes during allergy season
